title: PiiinMe!
tagline: A communty website where you can help to host currated content in one click by using multiple pinning services!
description:
This project is a community driven platform where you can find and pin content submitted by content creators.
The idea is to allow anyone to help host content on ipfs, so you can just reach the website and pin content you want to help.
If you want to use external pinning service you can add them on the fly and pin content on all service on the same time.
how_its_made:
PiinMe use js ipfs to power a local node directly on the browser so people can serve the content without particular knowledge or tools.

The website is generated with Nuxt and deployed on fleek.

The particular hack I've done is implement remote service api by myself because it is not available yet in js ipfs.
